newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 52,700 slaughter steers and 34,600 heifers; 88,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - All cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 69.00.
